judged_text: The handler's zod .parse, symmetricDecrypt, and JSON.parse calls all run without try/catch, so malformed request bodies, undecryptable ciphertexts, and non-JSON decrypted plaintexts escape as unhandled exceptions. Invalid input that should yield a 4xx returns a 500 instead (triggering webhook retries), and a mismatched CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY between the two instances turns every sync call into an indistinguishable 500 rather than an actionable configuration error.

adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` will throw on malformed input, and both `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...)` and the subsequent `JSON.parse(...)` can throw on undecryptable ciphertext or non-JSON plaintext. There is no surrounding try/catch or error-to-4xx mapping, so these cases will bubble up as unhandled exceptions and return a 500. This matches the finding that invalid input or a mismatched `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` would result in indistinguishable 500s rather than actionable 4xx responses.
